articles.title: Hakeem Jeffries on Track For Speaker Nomination in Wednesday Vote
articles.summary: When House Democrats gather Wednesday to choose their nominee for speaker, there will be little doubt about the outcome. Despite lingering divisions, Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York is on course to become the first Black American to lead the chamber after steering his party to victory in this month's midterm elections. articles.title: Irish Man Charged With Destroying U.S. Military Plane Becomes Protest Symbol
articles.summary: An Irish man has been charged in the U.S. with wielding an axe and using chemicals to destroy an American military plane in what supporters have described as a protest against the U.S. military. Federal prosecutors in Manhattan accused 48-year-old Daithí O’Corrain of damaging a $60 million U.S. Air National Guard aircraft while it was parked at Ireland’s Shannon airport in April. articles.title: U.S. Strikes Qeshm Island as Vance Says Iran Won’t Become ‘Forever War’
articles.summary: The U.S. and Iran exchanged attacks on Tuesday in the latest flare-up of the war that the Trump Administration promised would end after the U.S. midterms. American warplanes hit an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the crucial Strait of Hormuz waterway. articles.title: Mary Peltola Defeats Incumbent Republican in Alaska Senate Race
articles.summary: Democratic challenger Mary Peltola has defeated incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan in Alaska , rounding out one of the tightest and most controversial races of the midterm elections, and marking another notable GOP loss in what is typically a reliably red state. The Associated Press called the race on Tuesday evening, two weeks after Election Day , with Peltola securing 50.1% of the votes against Sullivan’s 45.8%.
